opencode-setup-guide.title: OpenCode SDK administrator configuration
opencode-setup-guide.intro: Prepare a complete configuration draft for a local or remote Runner. This guide only validates inputs and copies nonsecret JSON for an administrator to review and apply on the execution node.
opencode-setup-guide.runtime_versions: Use the fixed OpenCode SDK/server 1.19.4 and the complete suma-opencode-runtime assets. These are execution-node paths; entering them does not verify files or tool readiness.
opencode-setup-guide.field.node: Absolute path to the native Node executable
opencode-setup-guide.field.bundle: Absolute path to the SDK bundle (.mjs)
opencode-setup-guide.field.manifest: Absolute path to the SDK manifest (.json)
opencode-setup-guide.field.executable: Absolute path to the native OpenCode executable
opencode-setup-guide.paths_help: Use reviewed native Node and OpenCode executables with one complete SDK asset package. The Runner verifies actual files, manifest, dependencies and configuration; do not enter wrapper scripts or relative paths.
opencode-setup-guide.credential_help: Enter only a separate environment variable name already configured on the execution node, never a secret value. Platform, OpenCode, Node, NPM and system configuration variables are not allowed.
opencode-setup-guide.checks_help: Reference at most 16 distinct existing fixed text-v1 check command IDs from the same commands file. This guide does not create check commands; an empty list does not mean tests passed.
opencode-setup-guide.incomplete: Complete valid execution-node paths, provider, model, URL and any optional references before copying the configuration.
opencode-setup-guide.save: Have an administrator merge this entry into the node's existing commands file while retaining its configured check commands. This guide does not write files.
opencode-setup-guide.verify: Use the existing Runner inventory flow to verify local files, complete SDK assets and fixed configuration. A draft does not establish installation, model execution or health.
opencode-setup-guide.register: Register actual new inventory as paused, review its permissions and evidence, then explicitly enable it. Execution, candidates, independent tests and human acceptance remain separate checks.
opencode-setup-guide.boundary: The administrator fixes the provider and model; configuration acknowledgement does not verify the provider's actual model. Usage is observed without a provider spending cap. This guide does not log in, create tasks or register tools automatically.
